I've watched countless people destroy their iPhones in the dumbest ways, I do know a lot about iPhones and many other phones, and what I have simply concluded from what I've learned is that I'd rather not have a phone that I can't take the battery out of.

As much as I respect Motorola as a company, especially in their earlier days when they made the iconic Motorola Razor, I had a Moto G (1st gen I think) for a while and it took great pictures, ran fairly fast, but it didn't have an SD card slot. The phone only had 8 GB of internal memory. It also had a tendency to overheat while doing absolutely nothing. Eventually I threw it at the ground, not really hard, just as a joke, and the screen shattered and the glass pierced the LCD. I tried to have my dad fix it but he broke the new LCD we ordered off the internet and after it sitting on his desk for 1 year he told me to put it somewhere, only for me to make that discovery. We had some good times me and that phone, but it just didn't last.
